text: After Wake up, DREAM screen shows plain black (only menu + Skip button) for ~18 s wall time; tick stayed 0 for ~15 s before the black hole appeared. A new player would think it hung.

Dream: the photon ring around the black hole's shadow is drawn as a broken ring of separate dots/dashes rather than a continuous thin ring (visible in every dream frame and on the title). Looks like sampling holes beyond ordinary blur.

Dream: 22 game-seconds of silence between the first line (tick 144) and the second (tick 1502), with a nearly static image of the black hole; only three subtitle lines total. Felt long; I nearly hit Skip.

Quarters, facing the porthole: the 'E Look out of the porthole' prompt box sits on top of the bottom corners of the crosshair bracket. Also the controls hint lists WASD/E/Esc but never says how to turn (arrows or mouse).

Entering the corridor from quarters, facing the opposite wall: no objective/door marker on screen at all (the bridge door is ~74 deg to the side). The doorway sign said 'BRIDGE - FORWARD' but in the corridor I could not tell which way forward is.

Probe console panel: the ping interval is shown as 'every 10 M' with no explanation of what M is (only the subtitle says 'about 6 s'). 'rₛ' is explained, M is not; a new player won't know M is a unit of time.

Probe console panel after launch: the panel's vertical scrollbar runs up under the round menu (☰) button at top right; the button covers the scrollbar's top/up arrow. The panel is also taller than the screen, so the glossary at the bottom needs scrolling.

Back on the bridge after stepping out of the probe console (facing the probe console, yaw ~5): the centre crosshair dot is at screen centre (640,388) but the orange use-bracket is drawn ~110 px right and ~130 px lower, over the console screen; the 'E Use the probe console' prompt sits between them. It reads as two crosshairs.
